g.text: Home policy: conditional task p99 by pre-submit N/C or Q/C
Equal bounds do not mean equal task membership for N/C and Q/C. No pooled p99 or empty-bucket extrapolation.
* Fewer than 1,000 tasks: limited tail observations. One run; rounded terminal evidence, not raw-task recomputation.
